paper: Tracing Error Origins and Propagation: Dependency-Grounded Process Supervision for Mathematics and Physics
scope: Table 2(a), Table 2(b), and paired shared-label contrasts on PRM800K
type_table_average: six reference-supported classes, evaluated on reference new errors with known types
detection_threshold: maximum validation balanced accuracy; ties nearest 0.5 then smaller; include 0.5 as a candidate
role_threshold: maximum validation role macro-F1 on grid 0..1 step 0.001; ties nearest 0.5 then smaller

bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile; conditional on frozen trained models

data_format: Numeric NPZ arrays; float64 preserves original exported probabilities; allow_pickle=False
anonymization: Original identifiers and problem hashes replaced by order-preserving integer codes; no reverse mapping included
retained_content: labels, probabilities, within-trace step positions and numeric grouping codes only
omitted_content: problem statements, worked solutions, reasoning text, original IDs, original per-question hashes, model paths, credentials, training samples
